meaning: Static evidence and local headless validation. No original-game/browser/preview/GUI interaction. Source text normalizes CRLF; runtime logs, saves and built bytes are exact.

regression.note: First full run retained two original wall-cancellation failures. The entire core file was rerun serially without changing assertions, source, or test timeout. Final coverage uses the latest passing complete file result.

campaign.scope: Headless continuation of an exact retained v29 model-generated birth checkpoint. Only public commands, ordinary ticks and exact save/load mutate the world. No spawned animals, forged colony ownership, age, pregnancy, inventory, terrain, RNG or task edits. Demonstrates v48 young-female quota selection, real walking/work, in-progress reload, cancellation, one corpse and physical butchering; not full balance or native runtime evidence.

build.typecheck: tsc --noEmit passed as part of npm run build

limits: No native or browser gameplay/visual acceptance in this milestone.
Controlled unit fixtures are separate from the preserved historical model-generated saves.
The campaign continues a verified historical newborn; it does not repeat the entire breeding campaign in v48.
Animal bonds, products and full animal health are not implemented. Numbers remain provisional.
